exampleEn: I accidentally let slip the surprise party details.
exampleKo: 나는 실수로 서프라이즈 파티 정보를 털어놓았다.
gameExamples: During the meeting, he let slip that we might be getting a new project soon.
She didn't mean to let slip her friend's secret about moving to another city.
I was so tired that I let slip my plans for the weekend without thinking.
